top_signals.title: Bessent moved to military base amid 'growing threats' from Iran
top_signals.summary: Bessent's role leading Operation Economic Outcast has made him one of the Trump administration's top targets of Iranian threats, The New York Times reported.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iran-backed network directed London attacks over FaceTime, US prosecutors say
top_signals.summary: An indictment unsealed Tuesday says the broader campaign, targeting Jewish and American sites, included attacks on synagogues in Belgium, the Netherlands and London, and U.S. bank buildings in Amsterdam and Paris.
